name: seg_offset_to_linear_20bit
desc: Converts segment:offset address (DX:AX) to 20-bit linear physical address (DX:AX)
details: Takes a segmented pointer in DX:AX (DX = segment, AX = offset) and computes the 20-bit physical memory address (segment * 16 + offset). The resulting 20-bit physical address is returned in DX:AX, where AX contains bits 0-15 and DX contains bits 16-19 (the DMA/physical page register value).

ret.name: linear_addr
ret.desc: 20-bit physical/linear address: AX = bits 0-15 (page offset), DX = bits 16-19 (physical DMA page)

0823:0d73.comment: Rotate segment left by 4 bits: top nibble goes to bits 0-3, lower 12 bits shift up
